name: Dreaming Blue
source:
This visual novel takes place in a fantasy world where humans, gods, and spirits coexist. The protagonist has a curse that draws entities (strangelings) to her, so she must find a way to break the curse. She meets two gods who can help her fulfill her objectives.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2940920/Dreaming_Blue/?beta=0]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说发生在人类、神灵共存的奇幻世界。主角有一个诅咒，会吸引实体（怪人）到她身边，所以她必须找到打破诅咒的方法。她遇到了两位可以帮助她实现目标的神。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2940920/Dreaming_Blue/?beta=0]Steam[/url]]
